title: Oklahoma vs. Michigan Livestream: Here’s Where to Watch the College Football Game Live Online Free
summary: Saturday afternoon college football with the Sooners taking on the Wolverines — watch live on Saturday, Sept. 12
contentText:

After a very controversial 12-13 win in the very last second of the home opener against the Western Michigan Broncos, Michigan tries to grow in the ranks of NCAA College Football . The team’s new challenge is against a dominate Oklahoma team that completely decimated the University of Texas at El Paso with a final score of 0-51 in the Sooners’ home opening game

For week two of the season, the No. 11-ranked Oklahoma Sooners (1-0) takes on the unranked Michigan Wolverines (1-0) at Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

How to Watch Oklahoma Sooners vs. Michigan Wolverine Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Sept. 12

- Network: FOX

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , FOX One

Watch on DirecTV

When Does Oklahoma Sooners vs. Michigan Wolverine Start ?

Oklahoma vs. Michigan broadcasts on Saturday (Sept. 12) with kickoff at 12 p.m. ET/9 a.m. PT. The college football game airs live on FOX.

Who Is Performing During Oklahoma Sooners vs. Michigan Wolverine?

Since it’s a college football game, the halftime show won’t feature a popular recording artist. But, it features both schools’ marching bands performing for attendees and viewers watching at home.

However, there may be a few celebrity sightings at the game. Michigan celebrity fans and alumni who attended past games, like Tom Brady, Eminem, Dave Portnoy, Michael Phelps and others.
